reports.title: Twist Bioscience Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Financial Guidance
section: For the full fiscal year 2027, Twist expects:
•Total revenue in the range of approximately $550 million to $560 million, growth of approximately 21% year over year at the midpoint.
◦Initial full year revenue guidance assumes $100 million in revenue for AI drug discovery and sequential growth across both DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions and NGS Applications
